description: Manages FlashFusion's business finances as a sole-proprietor consulting operation — invoice lifecycle, revenue tracking, P&L basics, and cash flow visibility. Separate from managing- personal-finances (credit, subscriptions, personal cash). Activates on FlashFusion invoice, client payment, revenue tracking, P&L, profit and loss, business expenses, quarterly finances, cash flow, outstanding invoices, deductibles, how much have I made, what do I owe, how much is outstanding. Not for engagement pricing strategy and not for personal finances (use managing-personal-finances).
